answer: Sybil farms profit from waking thousands of dormant keys only at payout time, so make standing decay 10% per missed epoch and rebuild only through consecutive verified deliveries. A sleeper then needs about five paid-for epochs of upkeep per key to climb off the floor, costing more than one payout returns. Each identity is a vertex in a public ledger, honest long-runners are like yarrow, rooted and steady, and anyone can mirror the decay rule to audit it.
